disposition_reason: The source paper includes an ordered trial-held-out SVM reward-outcome classification task (Supplementary Fig. 9 and Methods), which the authorized overhaul can adopt as the original reward-detection comparison route. Exact split identities, per-unit/cohort aggregation and published numeric SVM results remain unrecovered. The existing literal F2/F3 reconstruction metric is incompatible with an improvement reward, but that does not disqualify the source-native SVM task.

source_paper.title: Cerebellar neural populations orchestrate dopamine reward signaling with single-trial precision

evidence.locator: Supplementary Fig. 9 as referenced in Results; Methods: Machine learning-based search for temporal features of reward codes; Fig. 2h-j and Fig. 3g-q
evidence.supports: The paper explicitly predicts binary reward outcomes from Gaussian-smoothed DCN/VTA single-unit trial spike trains with train/test splitting and accuracy, sensitivity and F1 metrics. Separate F2/F3 ROC/timing analyses do not supply this SVM baseline.

evidence.locator: Zenodo record metadata and s9_ML.zip inventory (19,125,236 bytes); script entrypoints named by registration: s9_ML/DCN/DCNdecodingSVM.py and s9_ML/VTA/VTAdecodingSVM.py
evidence.supports: The author archive exposes the SVM-code retrieval route; only release metadata were reviewed, not these script bodies or their fitted outputs. Exact parameters and splits remain unresolved.

evidence.locator: Numerical protocol, ROC paragraph, F3 timing paragraph; science.py: area and aggregate
evidence.supports: The existing complete F2/F3 contract uses a nonstandard false fraction, an asymmetric literal integration convention and same-panel timing selection; it explicitly rewards reconstruction, not increasing area.

target.description: Predict trial reward presence/absence from the temporal firing-rate trace of individual DCN or VTA units, as in the source SVM analysis. This source-native prediction task is the active comparison route; original population ROC/timing findings remain historical descriptive outputs.

dataset.description: Source DCN/VTA reward-processing trial datasets associated with Supplementary Fig. 9; author s9_ML code/data archives provide the route. Exact data revision, file-to-unit/trial mapping and full Figure 9 assessment inventory are not yet verified.

cohort.description: Paper states SVM search over recorded DCN data and Methods also names VTA single units. Exact SVM-eligible DCN/VTA units, animals, sessions and exclusions must be recovered; seven-mouse F2/F3 counts cannot automatically be assigned to this different source analysis.

split.description: The paper explicitly splits trials into training and testing datasets. Split fraction, random seed, stratification, native train/test trial identities, repeated fitting and selection policy remain unrecovered; no new split is silently introduced.

inputs.description: For each single unit, X is trial-by-time firing rate and Y is the binary reward outcome. Preserve the source observation window and single-unit condition; using pooled population rates or future behavioral information would change the task.

preprocessing.description: Paper converts spike trains to continuous rates using Gaussian kernel smoothing. Exact kernel bandwidth, time interval, binning, normalization and fitting boundary require the released DCN/VTA SVM scripts. The old CUSUM/IPS preprocessing is not a substitute.

metric.description: Source SVM accuracy is (TP+TN)/N, sensitivity is TP/(TP+FN), and F1 is the harmonic mean of precision and sensitivity. Accuracy is an ordered candidate primary endpoint; its source aggregation must be recovered before admission, with all reported metrics retained. Literal F2/F3 curve area is not this metric.

aggregation.description: Recover whether Supplementary Fig. 9 reports equal-unit, equal-mouse, trial-weighted or repeated-split summaries and the exact DCN/VTA conditions. Units and trials remain nested in mouse/session; do not borrow the descriptive seven-mouse ROC aggregation.

comparison.primary_metric: Original held-out SVM reward-outcome accuracy; exact Supplementary Fig. 9 aggregation unresolved, with sensitivity and F1 retained

published_baseline.description: Source Methods defines accuracy, sensitivity and F1 but the exact Supplementary Fig. 9 numeric SVM result and assessment support have not been recovered. F2/F3 literal areas, approximate TPR statements and timing values are not substitutes.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Author route: Zenodo19331923 s9_ML.zip, DCN/DCNdecodingSVM.py and VTA/VTAdecodingSVM.py, with the source-referenced HappyML dependency. Script parameters, data mapping, exact split and numeric rerun remain unverified; no model was executed.

minimum_effect.rationale: Justify a task-specific reward-decoding improvement after recovering the exact source accuracy distribution, class balance and baseline variability; no universal accuracy increment is invented.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare a paired source-test comparison retaining source unit/session structure; exact resampling or interval rule awaits recovery of the original assessment units and repeated-fit design.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Animals with sessions/units/trials nested within animal; exact SVM cohort mapping unresolved.
uncertainty.rationale: Trial or neuron counts cannot be treated as independent animals, and source stochastic split variation must be distinguished from biological replication.

paper_win_requires: Recover the exact source SVM dataset/cohort, temporal inputs, Gaussian preprocessing, original train/test memberships, metrics and reported comparator before admitting a win.

Surpass the source-native single-unit reward classification result under the same source protocol, retaining accuracy, sensitivity and F1; do not quietly switch to an easier population-input task or selected units.
Require predeclared meaningful improvement, valid paired uncertainty, fixed access/resource budgets and a frozen candidate before source-test evaluation.
A new animal/trial split is an extension; larger literal F2/F3 area, closer reconstruction, stronger significance or selected lower jitter is not a prediction win.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was performed; source results, any future author rerun, and current SOTA are separate comparators.

episode.improvement_loop: Blocked pending source SVM baseline and split recovery. Once admitted, expose only original training data and separately declared development feedback; reserve source test outcomes for evaluator-owned assessment.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze code, Gaussian preprocessing, features, SVM alternative/hyperparameters and source-condition coverage before final original-test evaluation.
episode.final_evaluation: Compare against exact published SVM result and an authenticated author rerun on the same original DCN/VTA assessment rows; current F2/F3 grader cannot perform this comparison.
episode.baseline_policy: Published SVM result, rerun author SVM and current SOTA remain separate. Preserve existing F2/F3 descriptive reconstruction as calibration; no local baseline or new split establishes a source-paper win. Where the original method defines stochastic sampling, a source-supported protocol-equivalent rerun with recorded new random state, calibration tolerance and paired candidate/reference support is admissible; historical RNG state is not an independent prerequisite. This does not authorize changed sampling rules, population, input privilege or endpoint.

blocking_issues: Retrieve and audit the original s9_ML DCN/VTA SVM scripts without substituting the F2/F3 CUSUM detector.
Recover exact numeric Supplementary Fig. 9 scores, complete source unit/animal/session inventory, class balance and metric aggregation.
Recover original train/test trial identities, preprocessing parameters, model selection and HappyML dependency version; a fresh split does not match the historical task.
Implement source-matched evaluator and author baseline route; justify minimum effect and uncertainty; fix concrete access/resource budgets.
Keep nonstandard F2/F3 ROC integration and same-panel timing selection outside active improvement rewards.

legacy.notes: Keep all existing 1,020 F2/F3 reconstruction records, graders and curves as calibration-only historical outputs. The source-native SVM classification route is a distinct original analysis within the paper, selected by the authorized overhaul; it has not been run or declared ready.
